title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Maya Patel
body:
Summary: Add opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, multiple tool-calling examples (HTTP data fetcher, SQL runner, internal ticket lookup), and update the docs site quickstarts and examples index. Motivation: make it straightforward for engineers to bootstrap production-appropriate RAG agents with recommended prompt templates, evaluation prompt sets, and end-to-end runnable examples across Python/TS SDKs. This PR bundles example code, templates, and docs site content so customers can follow a single quickstart path from concept -> local run -> deploy to Redwood Dedicated/Private.

What I changed: - new examples/redwood-rag-quickstarts/ containing three runnable playbooks: simple-rag-agent, tool-calling-rag, and enterprise-rag (with KMS/HSM note). - docs/site/content/quickstarts/rag-agent.md: step-by-step quickstart, minimal config, recommended batch/cache settings. - docs/site/content/examples/tool-calling.md: HTTP fetcher, SQL-runner adapter, ticket-search tool example. - redwood-examples/python/rag_agent_example.py and redwood-examples/ts/rag-agent-example.ts with README and local-run scripts. - added evaluation prompts and test harness under eval-harness/rag/ (small prompt set + expected behaviors) for regression monitoring.

Checklist: - [x] Add runnable Python example and tests - [x] Add TS example - [x] Docs quickstart written and linked from examples index - [x] Add evaluation prompt set + CI check - [x] Add example config for Dedicated and Private deployment notes - [x] Review and accessibility pass (Priya)

Testing & CI: Unit/examples smoke tests were run in CI. The first CI run reported a transient docs-site build failure (link-check) due to an external URL; I updated the anchor and re-ran; all checks are green. Local verification steps included running the Python quickstart with the included sample vector DB (sqlite-backed) and exercising tool-calling flows end-to-end with mocked HTTP/SQL backends.

Breaking changes: None. All new content is additive and lives under examples/docs paths.

Migration notes: N/A. This is documentation and example material only.

Commits summary: 1) Add base RAG agent templates and prompt scaffolding 2) Add Python/TS runnable examples and readmes 3) Add docs site quickstart and sidebar entries 4) Add eval-harness prompt set and CI integration 5) Fix docs link-check failure

Files touched (high level): - examples/redwood-rag-quickstarts/{simple-rag-agent,tool-calling-rag,enterprise-rag} - redwood-examples/python/rag_agent_example.py - redwood-examples/ts/rag-agent-example.ts - docs/site/content/quickstarts/rag-agent.md - docs/site/content/examples/tool-calling.md - eval-harness/rag/prompt-sets.json - docs/site/static/images/rag-architecture.png

How to review: Focus on the quickstart flow in docs/site/content/quickstarts/rag-agent.md, and run the smoke example locally following the README in redwood-examples/python. The tool-calling examples are small adapters intended as patterns — reviewers should validate security notes and that no secrets are checked in.

Related: Linear ENG-4857 (RAG quickstarts), DOCS-392 (docs site quickstart clean-up), previous RAG examples PRs in this area for pattern parity.

Merge outcome: squashed and merged to main after approvals and CI green.
